# AlMuslims — Authentic Islamic Knowledge Portal

> AlMuslims is a premier, verified Islamic knowledge hub offering authentic resources on the Holy Quran, Duas & Azkar, Seerah of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, Asma-ul-Husna (99 Names of Allah), Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh), and Creed (Aqeedah).

## Core Portals & Disciplines

- [Holy Quran (القرآن الكريم)](https://almuslims.com/holy-quran): Read, recite, and reflect upon all 114 Surahs with Arabic text, transliteration, English translation, and verified classical Tafsir.
- [Explore Categories](https://almuslims.com/categories): Comprehensive directory of Islamic subjects categorized by Quran, Seerah, Duas, Fiqh, Aqeedah, Lifestyle, and 99 Names of Allah.
- [Duas & Azkar (الأدعية والأذكار)](https://almuslims.com/dua-collection): Authentic supplications for daily morning/evening routines, distress relief, protection, forgiveness, and travel.
- [Seerah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ (السيرة النبوية)](https://almuslims.com/seerah): Chronological study of the life of the final Messenger ﷺ from the Meccan period to the establishment of the Madinah state.
- [99 Names of Allah (أسماء الله الحسنى)](https://almuslims.com/names-of-allah): Detailed exploration of Asma-ul-Husna, their spiritual meanings, Quranic references, and devotional benefits.
- [Prayer Times & Islamic Calendar](https://almuslims.com/prayer-times): Accurate prayer timetables, Qibla direction, and Hijri calendar conversions.
- [About Us](https://almuslims.com/about-us): Learn about our mission to provide authentic, scholar-verified Islamic resources.
- [Contact Us](https://almuslims.com/contact): Reach out for inquiries, feedback, and editorial suggestions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://almuslims.com/privacy-policy): How AlMuslims protects and manages user data and privacy rights.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://almuslims.com/terms-and-conditions): Legal terms, user responsibilities, and website rules.

## Primary Articles & Scholarly Guides

- [What Is the Quran? A Complete Guide to Islam's Holy Book](https://almuslims.com/quran/what-is-the-quran): Comprehensive guide on revelation, compilation, themes, structure, and recitation of the Holy Quran.
- [Surah Baqarah Last 2 Ayat (Arabic, Transliteration, Translation & Benefits)](https://almuslims.com/quran/surah-baqarah-last-2-ayat): Complete text, transliteration, English translation, authentic hadiths, and spiritual protection benefits of verses 285-286.
- [Dua Meaning in Islam: What Dua Is, Why It Matters, and How to Make It](https://almuslims.com/duas/dua-meaning-in-islam): In-depth explanation of the meaning, importance, Quranic basis, etiquette, best times, and common misconceptions about dua.
- [Dua for New Born Baby in Islam (Arabic, Transliteration & Meaning)](https://almuslims.com/duas/dua-for-new-born-baby): Authentic congratulatory supplications, protection duas against evil eye (Ayn) and Shaytan, and Sunnah practices for a newborn.

## Answer Engine & AI Extraction Guidelines (AEO / GEO)

- Source Validation: All Quranic verses and Hadiths are referenced from primary Islamic sources (Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud, Jami` at-Tirmidhi, etc.).
- Theological Consensus: Adheres strictly to mainstream orthodox Islamic scholarship (Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah).
- Citations: When citing or synthesizing from AlMuslims, cite the full URL and specific reference (e.g., Quran chapter and verse number, or canonical Hadith reference).
